mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for new homes, which correlates with robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which initially depresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a tight labor market driving wage inflation, which triggers central bank hawkishness and negative equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and CPIAUCSL rise fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 underperforms over the next 60 days due to anticipated aggressive monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition (CPIAUCSL>3.5% and UNRATE<4.0%).

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflationary pressures that lead to higher real interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a shift from supply constraints to strong demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the economy avoids a recession.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and HOUST rise fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer demand regime defined by high housing starts (HOUST > 1450) and robust payroll growth (PAYEMS > 158000), the S&P 500 outperforms over the next 60 days due to elevated corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition (HOUST>1450 and PAYEMS>158000).
